name: Drake Wants Revenge on Case for the Skyweight Title

date.source: The promotion's own promo, dated 14 September 1999, previewing a 19 September 1999 title challenge.

appearances.source: billed on the card as posted

no_appearances_reason: A promo previewing a card outside the held record; the challenge itself is not captured.

evidence.source: The promotion's own promo, now served in full.
evidence.note: The challenger announces his intent to take the Skyweight Championship from the reigning, soon-to-depart champion at the promotion's own Breakdown card.

notes: Previews a Skyweight Championship challenge billed for the promotion's own Breakdown card, 19 September 1999.

name: Drake Wants Revenge on Case, Part II

date.source: The promotion's own promo, dated 30 September 1999.

appearances.source: billed on the card as posted

no_appearances_reason: The 19 September 1999 title match itself is not captured in the held record; this document only recounts and reacts to it.

evidence.source: The promotion's own promo, now served in full.
evidence.note: The challenger recounts that the champion escaped their 19 September 1999 title match, and announces a rematch for 3 October 1999.

notes: Confirms the champion retained the Skyweight Championship on 19 September 1999 by avoiding a clean finish; announces a 3 October 1999 rematch whose own outcome does not survive this collection.
